pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderately crenulated and jagged edge gradients. Individual dark regions vary in spatial area, becoming more densely packed and smaller towards the ventral region and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, thick negative-space pathways of light cream pelage. The network forms a complex graph with high-connectivity junction nodes where three to five patch vertices converge. Pathway thickness remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, bristly mane is visible along the dorsal ridge from the upper neck to the shoulder. The 1D silhouette shows low-amplitude, high-frequency serration, though fine-scale pixel definition is softened by depth-of-field blur.
